adversarial.expectation: a fixture-only row must remain undecided until the new consumer compares an observed analysis with the row's hostile distinction

positive.expectation: the consumer must preserve exact surface reconstruction while returning an explicit supported, rejected or abstained disposition

candidate_population.population_source: the three tranche-001 Sarf hostile-fixture banks
candidate_population.selection_rule: all 99 rows in committed bank order; no sampling and no answer-key promotion

commands.expect: exit 0; all three banks remain fixture_only before implementation

commands.expect: failure before a real comparison consumer exists
commands.purpose: red-first: require a consumer test that rejects a no-op or answer-echo implementation

defeaters: The fixture's expected distinction is test data, not evidence and not a certified occurrence fact.
A byte-exact segmentation alone does not decide the hostile linguistic distinction.
A consumer that echoes fixture fields or guesses from surface shape is a false pass.
Rows needing occurrence evidence, two votes or scholar review must abstain and preserve that route.
definition_of_done: all 99 rows are compared through a real allow-listed consumer with observed call counts
every row is supported, rejected or explicitly abstained with a typed reason
mutation tests reject an answer-echo consumer, a no-op consumer and an overgeneralizing surface-only consumer
the three bank dispositions and measured pins are updated without certifying facts or producing public output

conditions: a fixture cannot be evaluated without occurrence evidence absent from the repository
a proposed distinction requires two-vote or scholar judgment
implementation would require a prohibited file
escalation_trigger.route: abstain with the exact missing evidence or review class; do not infer a linguistic answer from the fixture

evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: Expected fixture content never certifies or supplies the analysis. The consumer must derive its result from repository authority and may abstain.
evidence_policy.statement: Use committed Fusha rules, procedures and occurrence evidence. External expression and private curriculum prose remain excluded.

expected_outputs.description: A real hostile-fixture comparison consumer with explicit abstention and observed call counts.
Red-first unit tests covering answer echo, no-op behavior and overgeneralization.
Measured bank dispositions and pins after the consumer is proven.

guards: Only the method transfers; the packet never pre-writes a linguistic conclusion for the executor to copy.
Abstention is a valid result and a forced decision is a defect.
A fixture result never certifies a root, lemma, pattern, sense, function or occurrence fact.
This packet authorizes NO certification, NO rule promotion and NO public output.
The eval banks, rule stores, skill registries, lattice and certification stores remain immutable.

non_deployment.statement: Nothing in this packet mutates a live surface, entry data, certification state or a public projection.

out_of_scope: Do not change the 99 committed Sarf fixture rows.
Do not decide an occurrence fact from an expected fixture answer.
Do not touch Naḥw banks, LargeLexicon, Qamus entry data, projectors, certification stores or live systems.
scope.summary: The three tranche-001 Sarf hostile-fixture banks contain 99 clean-room fixture rows and are structurally routed through the real segmenter, but no production consumer compares its analysis against their linguistic distinctions. Build one fail-closed comparison consumer for the coherent 99-row family, preserving abstention and the candidate/certified boundary.

title: Build one fail-closed consumer for the 99 tranche-001 Sarf hostile fixtures
